title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Upgrading to the Highest Qualifying Money Market Tier
content:
An owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts product may ask for the account to be moved up to the best money market tier open to them. This page is the entry point for that request: what it decides, and how the resulting tier change is put on record.

## What the policy governs

- **The request.** The owner wants a savings or money market account moved to the highest-ranked money market tier for which it qualifies.
- **The result.** The target tier, which may turn out to be the account's present tier, in which case nothing is converted.
- **The handling.** Where the target differs from the present tier, the account is converted to it as a tier conversion of the existing account.

## Recording the conversion

The agent carries this out: unlock `convert_savings_tier_d500151b` using `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and invoke it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Capability.** A call changes the account's tier, and nothing else, to the tier named, with effect from today; the account number, balance and history stay as they were. The account lookup afterwards shows the new tier name.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|
| `savings_account_id` | reference number of the account being converted, as the savings account lookup returns it | an identifier |
| `variant_name` | official name of the tier the account moves into | exactly one of `Starter Savings`, `Statement Savings`, `Goal Builder Savings`, `Money Market Account`, `Premier Money Market`, `Private Client Money Market` |

The six names, in the tool's own terms, are the entry savings tier, the standard statement savings tier, the goal-based savings tier, the standard money market tier, the higher-balance money market tier, and the money market tier reserved for Private Client Checking customers.

## Receipt

A dictionary rendered as text with `savings_account_id`, `previous_tier` (the tier before the call) and `new_tier` (the tier after it). When `new_tier` matches the tier requested, the conversion is on record.

## Quick answers

**Does the tool decide which tier is best?** No. It records the tier it is given; choosing the target is a matter of policy.

**Does the tool check the customer's eligibility?** No. It performs the change only; eligibility rests with the policy and the records.
